name: min-restore-click
what: 0277 (E8): the main window minimized with FL's own minimize button (a mouse click on it, as a user does), #taskbar-restore appears; the page's button is clicked (DOM click); the main window is back

ops.name: tb-0-start
ops.js: (async () => { const b = document.getElementById('taskbar-restore'); if (!b) return 'no #taskbar-restore'; const r = b.getBoundingClientRect(); const d = document.getElementById('desktop').getBoundingClientRect(); const a = document.activeElement; return JSON.stringify({ hidden: b.hidden, display: getComputedStyle(b).display, text: b.textContent, title: b.title, rect: [Math.round(r.x), Math.round(r.y), Math.round(r.width), Math.round(r.height)], desktopRect: [Math.round(d.x), Math.round(d.y), Math.round(d.width), Math.round(d.height)], active: a ? (a.id || a.tagName) : null, count: document.querySelectorAll('#taskbar-restore').length }); })()

ops.name: press-restore
ops.js: (async () => { const b = document.getElementById('taskbar-restore'); if (!b || b.hidden) return 'not shown'; b.click(); return 'clicked'; })()
